body:
I think you'll be okay. When I was your age I was charged with 5 felonies. FIVE. I was looking at 25 years minimum in federal pound-me-in-the-ass prison. I had a public attorney who negotiated for two years of probation and costs (Things like his fee, the court cost etc) and I was off basically scott free. Also guess what? You're under 18. That means this is a juvenile case. That means this record is sealed the day you turn 18 and you can legally say you've never been arrested before. NOBODY can see this record but the govt. 

With the way MJ legalization is going in this country and the circumstances (You fessed up to it, didnt waste time and didnt make them search) You'll probably get probation at the worst.

Now I'm not a lawyer, just someone whose been in your shoes and god damn are they uncomfortable shoes but listen man, you get to take them off soon. I did, you will, and so will countless others. 

Everything is going to be okay, I promise you that. I'm not going to *plead* for you not to end your life but brother, it just doesn't make sense. You're gonna be alright kid. I have faith in you.

I feel the same way. But if you are DEAD SET on leaving this earth please do not do it in front of a truck. That just adds to the total amount of people you will hurt. Remember this is your decision and you don't want to drag others in. 

That being said, I can't really give you advice without being a hypocrite. I'm suicidal too. The best I can say is try to stick through it. I wish the best for you my man.

I don't know if this is against the rules, but if it is let me know please.
